description_en: Queries the information about a workflow
description_zh: 调用GetBusiness查询业务流程的详情

parameters.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID. You must specify either this parameter or ProjectIdentifier to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied.
parameters.description_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间。
